title: Question Transfer
subtitle: Moves questions, tests, activities and the catalog between environments. Move the catalog first, then the rest: questions reach their topics and tests reach their grades through the catalog.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Grades, subjects, topics, subtopics and outcomes. Records missing from the file are not deleted.
catalog.invalidFile: This file could not be read. Choose a file saved with Download catalog.
catalog.failed: The catalog could not be loaded. Nothing was written.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Choose the questions. When the job finishes, download the package from the list below.
export.subject: Subject
export.failed: The export could not start. Try again.
export.worksheetsNote: Selected tests and activities move with their questions. Assignments, sessions and results do not move.
export.worksheetsFailed: Tests and activities could not be loaded.
export.worksheetsEmpty: No test or activity matches this selection.
export.worksheetsTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} records. If you cannot find one, narrow the list.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Choose a package, see what will happen, then import it.
import.previewLoading: Checking the package. A large one can take a few minutes.
import.previewFailed: The package could not be checked. Choose a zip downloaded from an export.
import.failed: The import could not start. Try again.
import.unpublishNote: {{count}} questions unpublished in the source will be unpublished here too. Do not continue if this is an old package.
import.conflictsNote: Conflict: the same image is here with different content. These questions are not imported and the question here does not change.
import.missingTaxonomyNote: Questions whose topic is not found arrive without one. Move the catalog first.
import.unhashedNote: {{count}} questions here have not been scanned yet, so the counts may be low. The scan is running in the background.

worksheets.title: Tests and activities
worksheets.closedNote: Tests and activities arrive closed: other teachers do not see them, students start them only through an assignment, and they add no questions to free practice. You become their owner. Questions already here are not copied.
worksheets.blockedNote: A blocked test or activity is not created, its questions are still imported:

jobs.title: Recent Jobs
jobs.downloadFailed: The package could not be downloaded. Try again.
